logline: Catherine enters the wet cells armed with a red-hot iron and Juliana's late mother's botanical book, subjecting the chained heiress to ruthless psychological torment until Juliana's unyielding pride pushes Catherine to a violent brink.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 30 where Rupert and Catherine plotted to frame Juliana as a witch while Juliana huddled chained in the subterranean dungeon.

events.description: Static medium shot of the heavy, iron-studded dungeon door as the massive bolt loudly slides open.
Heavy iron latch sliding back with an ominous, echoing metallic clang, followed by the deep groaning creak of the cell door swinging inward.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Medium close-up of Juliana huddled against the stone wall, bound in heavy iron chains, shivering in her torn apron and lifting her tear-streaked face in dread.
Juliana recoils against the damp stonework, her eyes wide with terror as light floods into the dark cell.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Full shot framed through the arched doorway. Catherine stands imperiously in an ornate, gold-embroidered violet gown, holding a smoldering hot poker and a charred leather-bound book, flanked by two stone-faced guards with lanterns.
Look at you.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up from the stone floor, her gaze hardening despite her fear.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Tight close-up of Catherine's face, bathed in the orange flickering glow of the red-hot branding iron, smiling with pure malice.
The great Lady Juliana Ashcroft.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Over-the-shoulder wide shot past Catherine looking down at Juliana shackled helplessly on the wet stone floor.
Chained in a dungeon like a common criminal.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, speaking with quiet defiance.
You seem very pleased.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Low-angle shot looking up at Catherine towering over Juliana, holding the glowing poker at her side.
I am.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Extreme close-up of the bent, white-hot tip of the poker radiating heat, with Catherine's face blurred in the background as she gazes down with predatory pleasure.
Because this is what you were always meant to be.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Over-the-shoulder medium shot focusing on Juliana as Catherine presents the charred, singed pages of the botanical book.
Your family dressed you like a lady. They educated you. They gave you a respectable name.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Close-up of Catherine's face breaking into an arrogant, haughty laugh.
[chuckles] And still you became a disgrace.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Tight close-up of Juliana's fierce, unwavering gaze as she retorts without hesitation.
I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Close-up of Catherine scowling, cutting back to a shot of Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron manacles against the cold stone floor.
No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Medium shot from floor level looking up at Catherine leaning closer, savoring Juliana's humiliation.
Do you remember?
Juliana stares up, her breathing steadying as she refuses to break under Catherine's barbs.
Everyone saw you. Everyone watched him chose Clarisse.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Close-up of the red-hot iron hovering over the damp stone floor, rising steam and heat waves warping the air, before cutting to Catherine's gloating expression.
Faint sizzling and hissing as ambient moisture touches the scalding iron tip.
And everyone watched you walk away alone.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Close-up pushing in on Juliana's illuminated, dignified face.
Gerald chose money.
Clarissa chose a coward.
I chose myself.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Close-up of Catherine's face tightening in disgust.
You chose a beggar.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Low-angle shot of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering pride.
I chose a man.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Medium shot of Catherine sneering down at her.
A scarred nobody.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Medium shot of Juliana sitting erect against the dungeon wall, her hands resting calmly in her lap.
A man with more honor than the people sitting above this dungeon.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Medium close-up of Catherine, holding the smoldering iron between them.
You call that marriage?

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Extreme close-up of Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with profound conviction.
I call it love.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: High-angle wide shot looking straight down through the ceiling iron grating into the deep dungeon shaft where Catherine looms over Juliana.
[laughs] Love? Look where your precious love brought you.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking directly up past the glowing tip of the iron poker into Catherine's eyes.
To a place where I can still look you in the eyes.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Close-up of Catherine, her lips curling in indignant disbelief.
You think love makes you better than me?

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Close-up of Juliana speaking calmly and razor-sharp.
No. But cruelty certainly doesn't make you better than me.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Medium shot of Catherine sweeping her arm out, flaunting her aristocratic privilege and opulence.
I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Close-up of Juliana, her expression serene and grounded in moral superiority.
Knowledge. Love. And people who need me.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Tight shot of Catherine's gloved hands holding Juliana's mother's partially burned botanical volume, 'The Virtues of Plants & Herbs'.
[scoffs] Peasants? People?

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Medium shot of Catherine casually holding the ancient book while pacing slowly before Juliana.
That is why you were born in the wrong world. Women like me are meant to be admired. Women like you are meant to serve.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Tight close-up of Juliana's face, tilting her head with an insightful, knowing smirk.
Then why are you so desperate to make me kneel?
Catherine's smug expression freezes, her eyes widening in momentary shock and fury as the blow lands squarely.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Low-angle medium shot of Juliana, her voice ringing clearly through the subterranean chamber.
If you were truly powerful, Catherine, you wouldn't need me to bow.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Close-up of Catherine completely losing control, her aristocratic facade shattering into sheer rage.
Enough!

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Close-up of the red-hot poker pressing directly down into the delicate open pages of the botanical book.
Hiss of scorched parchment and curling white smoke rising as paper blackens under extreme heat.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Medium two-shot. Catherine holds the smoldering book right before Juliana's face.
This pathetic book is the only thing you still have from your mother.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Extreme close-up of Juliana, her emotional composure breaking into pure grief and panic.
Tears spill rapidly down Juliana's cheeks as she reaches forward in vain, restrained by her heavy iron chains.
[gasping] Give it back!

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Low-angle shot of Catherine grinning with sadistic triumph, looking down at Juliana's despair.
There. Finally. Something still hurts you.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Close-up of Juliana screaming out in absolute anguish.
No!

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Medium close-up of Catherine slowly driving the glowing branding tip into the spine of the open book, watching the embers consume the pages.
One flame, and your mother's life's work becomes ash.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Low-angle medium shot. Catherine lowers the charred book and suddenly swings the glowing orange iron tip straight up toward Juliana's face.
Juliana recoils back against the hard dungeon wall, gasping for breath in raw terror as the searing iron stops inches from her eyes.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.description: Extreme macro close-up of Juliana's wide, trembling eye. The brilliant orange ember of the hot poker reflects clearly in the center of her pupil, holding on the terrifying cliffhanger before an abrupt cut.

beats.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
